ueba.hoursNotJudged: Unusual hours are only judged with at least {min} baseline events covering {share}% of the prior {baseline}. This user’s history is shorter, so no hour is flagged.
ueba.noHistory: No data in the prior {baseline} for {streams}, so nobody there is called first seen.
ueba.volumeNotJudged: Volume is not judged for this user: windows under a day are compared with the same hours of day in the baseline, which needs at least a day of history.
